scope: Corollary 6.7 (Strict compact-magnetic numerical extension) of the manuscript “A Charged Reduction of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality in Spatial Dimensions at Least Four” (preprints/A-Charged-Reduction-of-the-Spacetime-Penrose-Inequality-in-Spatial-Dimensions-at-Least-Four-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e5e445d305051a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let the original exterior satisfy the numerical geometric and asymptotic hypotheses, and let Dm be an arbitrary smooth compactly supported closed two-form. With α = iE volg closed, use the electromagnetic convention Ig(v) = c2 n ( |E|2 g + |Dm|2 g + 2Dm(v, E) ) , µm + Jm(v) = µ + J(v) − Ig(v). (6.62) Assume also that µm, |Jm|g are integrable and that the ADM and charge flux limits exist with the stated normalizations. Assume the ADM vector is future timelike, the fixed componentwise trapping inequalities are strict, and for some c > 0 and 0 < β < min(1, q), µm − |Jm|g ≥ cr−n−β . (6.63) Then, with the original full-cut infimum a and the original normalized electric charge Q, m ≥ s|Q| + 1 − s2 2 XA (0 < s < 1). (6.64) Equivalently, m ≥ |Q|, and when XA > |Q| one also has m ≥ (XA + Q2/XA)/2. No magnetic equality classification or non-timelike extension is asserted here.
